messages:
Jordan: heads-up — saw a ~30% TTFT regression on route /v1/generate-small starting 2026-02-18 03:22 UTC. decode_time per-token looks steady, but kernel_time/ms-per-token jumped across canary nodes. digging in. :eyes:
Priya: do you have a quick sample of the per-token breakdown (ttft vs decode vs kernel)?
Jordan: pasted a tiny tail sample from the probe run:
```
route="/v1/generate-small" model="rwd-neo-1.3b" seq_len=128 kv_hit=true
token_idx=45 kernel_time_ms=3.2 decode_time_ms=0.9 ttft_ms=8.1
token_idx=46 kernel_time_ms=3.4 decode_time_ms=0.8 ttft_ms=8.5
```
Marta: hmm that kernel_time jump (+~2.5ms baseline) smells like a kernel choice change or kernel-requeue noise on the new microkernel path. we should add a per-route "kernel_frac" sparkline in Console + a waterfall view for sampled traces.
Kevin: agree. proposed metric expression (for observability):
```
kernel_frac = sum(kernel_time_ms) / (sum(kernel_time_ms) + sum(decode_time_ms))
rollup: 1m, group_by: route, model
```
Kevin: also add p50/p95 for per-token delta: (kernel_time_ms - baseline_kernel_ms). that helps spot regressions vs model/version.
Marta: sampling note: full per-token traces are expensive. suggest stratified sampling: 0.5% global but 5% for seq_len>256 and 2% for kv_hit=false. that surfaces cold-cache behavior.
Ciara: +1. for Console panels: 1) sparkline kernel_frac (route-level) 2) stacked token-waterfall (ttft split) 3) table: model/version + kernel_frac delta vs baseline 4) alert if kernel_frac increases >20% over 1h baseline.
Jordan: can we implement without blowing ingest? keep traces to 1. enable aggregation at probe side (emit sums/counts) and only full traces for sampled ids.
Priya: quick query for the probe implementer: how do we attribute KV work? want prefetch vs local-lookup split. propose tags: kv_prefetch_ms, kv_local_ms.
Marta: yep add both tags; then kernel_time_ms - kv_prefetch_ms - kv_local_ms gives pure compute kernel time (approx). include a note in the schema.
deploy-bot: probe-deploy: kernel-sparkline-probe v1 scheduled to canary (nodes: canary-rt-1..3) — rollout window 2026-02-19 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Jordan: nice. @Marta can you own the dashboard PR? @Ciara wants the alert thresholds?
Marta: I got it. will open PR with the metric, panel mocks, and sample-rate config. aiming for EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Ciara: I'll draft alert runbook and thresholds, will link to PR.
Kevin: keep sample-rate <=1% by default. if we see variance we can temporarily bump for a short window.
Jordan: thanks all. once probe is live i'll run a quick diff against last-7d baseline and share.
Priya: cheers.
Jordan: closing loop — ping me if you need any more traces from that canary set.
